name: Mox Self-Hosted Mail Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted mail server with SMTP, IMAP, webmail, DNS setup guidance and transactional email HTTP API; no vendor-imposed mailbox or sending quota in the software.
watch_out: Requires your own server, domain, DNS, IP reputation, storage, backups and operational security. SMTP deliverability and VPS/network costs are not included; hosting providers may block port 25. MIT license covers software, not third-party infrastructure.
